from pathlib import Path
import shutil

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
for relative in ("model", "blender_mcp", "spider-game/public/models"):
    path = root / relative
    if path.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(path)

scripts = root / "spider-game/scripts"
remove = (
    "check-animation.js",
    "check-textures.py",
    "diagnose-gait.js",
    "diagnose-remy-gait.js",
    "inspect-elemental.js",
    "inspect-glb.cjs",
    "inspect-production.js",
    "inspect-remy-rig.js",
    "merge-remy-idle.js",
    "read-test-glb.js",
    "repair-remy-gait.js",
)
for name in remove:
    path = scripts / name
    if path.exists():
        path.unlink()

remaining = sorted(path.name for path in scripts.iterdir())
print("Removed assigned 3D resource directories and specialized scripts.")
print("Remaining scripts:", ", ".join(remaining))
Path(__file__).unlink()
